## Day 83 Solution: Automation-as-a-Service

A real SLA monitoring workflow: **Schedule Trigger** (every 15 min) -> **HTTP Request** to the n8n Executions API -> **Code** node computing the real success rate over the window -> **Airtable** logs every check (so a month-end compliance number is real, not guessed) -> **IF** compares against the stated SLA threshold -> **Slack** alert fires only on an actual breach.

**Credentials needed to run this for real:** n8n API key for the Executions call; Airtable (or Google Sheets) for the compliance log; Slack API for the breach alert.

**Matches:** `DAILY_TASKS/DAY_83_Automation_as_a_Service.md`

## Real Tiers (solo operator, honest capacity)

**Basic** — $297/mo — up to 3 workflows, email support, 24h response, 99% uptime (monitored, best-effort fix).

**Professional** — $697/mo — up to 10 workflows, Slack support channel, 4h response business hours, 99% uptime with this monitoring workflow live.

**Enterprise** — custom (from $1,500/mo) — unlimited workflows, 1h response, 99.9% uptime target — **not committed solo** until a second responder is hired (Day 80).

**Billing:** monthly recurring, auto-invoiced on the 1st. Missed payment -> 3-day grace -> automation paused, client notified -> reinstated on payment. Upgrade: prorated charge same day, new tier limits active immediately.

This tab's threshold below is set to the **Basic/Professional** number (99%) so the workflow reflects what's actually promised today.
